notes.title: Ergastulum Dev Updates
notes.content:
Welcome Isserley to the Ergastulum Project
I want to start off by welcoming Isserley to the Ergastulum project. Isserley is going to be composing the original score, which will comprise of Industrial noisiness, ambience and even a little classical! Here is a short blurb from her own mouth.

I've played the beta a whole bunch and you're in for a real treat, as long as you consider being on edge for hours on end a treat

And from what she has produced so far, this game is not only going to be a real hellish treat for your eyes but also for your ears. Stay tuned for more updates soon and make sure to check out her Facebook page.

Even More Enemies?!?
https://i.imgur.com/hEzzxHe.gif

In other news, I recently created something that was inspired by an old movie called Salem's Lot.

https://i.imgur.com/D7uApEb.png

https://i.imgur.com/Y2O2Kdm.png

For those that have seen it may remember THAT window scene.

notes.title: Ergastulum - Development Update
notes.content:
Ergastulum development is still going strong! Please add the game to your Wishlist for the latest development updates :)

A lot of changes have happened recently and I wanted to share some of the latest additions to the game.

Most recently, I have started to work on the traps found in the dungeons and will be a re-imagination of what I did in Dungeon Nightmares II.

Pendulums
https://i.imgur.com/4aErmdW.png

A Close Shave
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sIZaz5MO4FQ

Crushers
https://i.imgur.com/cpgNrdE.png

notes.title: Dungeon Nightmares Difficulty
notes.content:
I was curious about what players felt about the challenge my games bring (mainly the Dungeon Nightmares difficulty).

When I was making the sequel, the game was a lot easier (in my mind) but during the final weeks of development, I made the choice to make it harder, more challenging, and stay true to itself. I still firmly believe that this was the right decision.

However, as I in the process of designing my next game (unannounced) I wanted to through a quick poll out there about difficulty.

Here are the results of the poll on Twitter after 24 hours:


33% Make it harder, I'm crazy
44% Don't change a thing
23% Too much of a nightmare


The results seem to agree with my original feelings that players like the challenge my games bring. However, feel free to keep discussing this here or in the forums here :)

http://steamcommunity.com/app/382090/discussions/0/365163686059386194/
